# XORMetaResiduals

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A deep spiking network architecture that uses exclusive-OR (XOR) operations to create meta-residual connections, facilitating gradient flow and deeper network training. This addresses the vanishing gradient problem in deep spiking networks, enabling more complex hierarchical processing in neuromorphic systems for TCC/iNEST tasks.
